liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Corinna** (3 reviews): Reviewer says the Corinna is fiery enough to get anyone excited; Reviewer likes the chant-beat intro but wanted more development and interwoven rhythmic jamming [13][14][17]
- **Stagger Lee** (2 reviews): Reviewer thinks this may be the best Stagger Lee ever, with exquisite Jerry solos; Reviewer calls this the best Stagger Lee they have heard [23][24]
- **Masterpiece** (1 review): Reviewer says the show really takes off at Masterpiece [23]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): A mild Eyes opens the second set and leads into Corinna [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Cold, Rain, Snow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-12-11.schoeps.boardman.swayne.86009.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 153 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Very minor split-second dropouts occur at the start of Looks Like Rain and Sunshine Daydream [1]
- **gd1992-12-11.schoeps.boardman.swayne.86010.sbeok.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 153 min [2]. Said about its sound: Very minor split-second dropouts occur at the start of Looks Like Rain and Sunshine Daydream [2]
- **gd92-12-11.sbd-2track.scott.9534.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 151 min; rated 2.83/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the mix great and the sound crystal clear, with prominent bass in the Phil Zone; Reviewer hears a good recording and remastering with no noticeable sound problems; Keyboards and drums sit too loud in the mix, while Weir's guitar and the bass are low [14][15][16][17]
- **gd92-12-11.akg.vernon.9773.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 151 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording that seems to be front-of-board, with very good stereo spread and beautiful fidelity [18]
- **gd1992-12-11.fob.neumann.copeland.gems.79264.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 157 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer prefers this front-of-board recording over the other available recordings of the show [24]
- **gd1992-12-11.sbd.stonebear.5548.shnf**: soundboard; 15 songs; 146 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [12]. Said about its sound: Reviewer praises the Healy soundboard mix as great sounding [19]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says shows they saw at the Coliseum were always special [24]
- Reviewer ranks this among the five best 1992 shows [13]
- Reviewer finds this 1990s show tight but lacking the deep emotion of 1980s performances [19]
- Reviewer links this Stella Blue to one played on the same date in 1972, twenty years earlier [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-12-11.schoeps.boardman.swayne.86009.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ed Boardman; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: Schoeps CMC-441's > Panasonic SV-255> DAT (clone) [1]
- **gd1992-12-11.schoeps.boardman.swayne.86010.sbeok.flac1648**: taped by Ed Boardman; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: Schoeps CMC-441's > Panasonic SV-255> DAT (clone) [2]. Also: This copy is down-sampled to 44.1k for audio CD burning; a 48k version was also seeded [2]
- **gd92-12-11.sbd-2track.scott.9534.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Soundboard recorded directly to DAT; Soundboard DAT master copied to DAT, then CDR, then iMac, then SHN; shntool-fixed by Nathan Scott [3][16]
- **gd92-12-11.akg.vernon.9773.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording [7]
- **gd1992-12-11.fob.neumann.copeland.gems.79264.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Chip Copeland; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Neumann km140 (110 deg. ORTF) -> Neumann Supply -> Panasonic sv255 [8]. Also: Taped on DAT by Todd Evans, from his GEMS series of recordings [8]
- **gd1992-12-11.sbd.stonebear.5548.shnf**: source: Dan Healy 2 track pa sbd dat master > Healy cassette (made by Dan for Phil Lesh) > absconded & confiscated by Dick Latvala : ^) > analog to digital by kingbee… [12]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 11, 1992](https://www.dead.net/show/december-11-1992) [26]
- Poster by Fred Strame Grateful Dead: [1992-12-11 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-12-11-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [27]
